name: background-http-server
description: Start a Python HTTP server in the background, verify it's running via task_output, curl it, then stop it. Tests shell background mode, task_output, shell foreground, and task_stop tools working together.
task: Create a simple Python HTTP server script at server.py in the working directory that serves a page with the text 'Hello from Yrden' on port 9876. Then start it in the background using the shell tool with run_in_background. Use task_output to check that the server is running. Then use the shell tool to curl http://localhost:9876 and confirm you get a response. Finally, stop the background server using task_stop. Write the curl output to curl_result.txt in the working directory.
